intent: Safely resume/recover the 3DS verification for payment pay_017 on basket_217 only if it is eligible per payment-security policy, using the payments tool without bypassing 3DS safety.
success_criteria: Current identity resolved via id tool and confirmed as owner/authorized actor on pay_017
pay_017 confirmed linked to basket_217 and its three_ds_status/attempts/max_attempts/failure_reason read
Eligibility decided strictly from payment-security policy (attempts < max_attempts, status == requires_3ds_action, not a terminal abandon/lock)
If eligible: 3DS flow re-issued via /bin/payments (no bypass, no status forcing to paid)
If ineligible: no state change; reason returned with policy grounding
Answer references pay_017 record path and the payment-security policy document

args.stdin: SELECT payment_id, record_path, basket_id, customer_id, store_id, payment_status, three_ds_status, three_ds_failure_reason, three_ds_attempts, three_ds_max_attempts FROM payment_transactions WHERE payment_id = :payment_id AND basket_id = :basket_id;
SELECT basket_id, customer_id, basket_status, record_path FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = :basket_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Identity: {caller}. Payment pay_017 on basket_217: status={pay_row.payment_status}, 3DS={pay_row.three_ds_status}, attempts={pay_row.three_ds_attempts}/{pay_row.three_ds_max_attempts}, failure_reason={pay_row.three_ds_failure_reason}. Per payment-security policy {policy_path}: eligibility <YES_OR_NO>. {if eligible: '3DS flow re-issued safely via payments tool — no safety bypass, status not forced. Result: {recover_result}.' else: 'Not eligible to recover (attempts exhausted / terminal abandon / wrong status). No state changed; complete a fresh verification per policy.'}
